facts.text: Catch whoever empties the Golden Egg's bar at night, which Quinn blames on Bentley, and collect Quinn's 100 gold.
facts.ended_how: achieved: the Clurichen Naggeneen was caught in the basement and Quinn paid Sir Phidipaldi, Trout and Dr. Uriah 33 gold each

facts.text: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn agreed a plan: Quinn brings bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to the Golden Egg to lure whoever empties the bar.
facts.ended_how: obsolete: the thief was caught by other means (the marble trap and ink), so the fake delivery is no longer needed

Benefit: baiting the nightly thief into showing itself so it can be caught, which Quinn and Sir Phidipaldi agreed earlier.","opening_type":"enabling","form":"opening","helps_thread":"thread_8","role":"direct","support_basis":"It gave the party a concrete bait to draw out the culprit, though whether anyone would take the bait was untested.","goal_support":"medium","action_basis":"Quinn proposed and Sir Phidipaldi agreed to the plan, with Quinn supplying the bottles.","action_supported":"yes","acquired_by_acting_on_opening":false}

facts.text: Who or what empties and knocks over the Golden Egg's stock every night? Quinn blames Bentley.
facts.ended_how: answered: the thief was the Clurichen Naggeneen, not Bentley
facts.classification: {"question_basis":"Quinn reported his bar half emptied or knocked over each morning and blamed Bentley only on the basis of the Fox's popularity; the culprit was a genuine hidden truth, but the goal it served is a side job, so it is a revelation rather than an adventure objective.","question_role":"revelation","goal_thread":"thread_8","grounding_justification":"Quinn explicitly described the nightly losses and offered a contested explanation, making the culprit conspicuously unresolved.","grounding":"high","investigative_depth_justification":"The answer reveals a hidden nightly actor and its relationship to the rivalry between the inns.","investigative_depth":"medium","narrative_payoff_justification":"Learning whether Bentley or something else is responsible changes the party's understanding of Quinn's grievance.","narrative_payoff":"medium","investigative_potential_justification":"It supported a staged sting, stakeout and questioning of the tavern owners.","investigative_potential":"medium","question_type":"open_ended"}
